title: Bernoulli's principle
description: Where a flowing liquid or gas speeds up, its pressure drops. It's why a perfume atomiser sprays, a carburettor sucks in fuel, and a shower curtain billows inward.
effect: a fluid's pressure drops where it flows faster
pickWhy: Borderline: the deck's Kinetic gases card is from the same 1738 book by the same author, but it's about a different effect, so this gets its own card.
edbDesc: For an inviscid flow, an increase in the speed of the fluid occurs simultaneously with a decrease in pressure or a decrease in the fluid's gravitational potential energy
